title: OpenCode review-finding envelope v1
description: Envelope for findings emitted by qa-doctor and code-flow-analyst subagents. Adapted from /tmp/gentle-ai/contracts/review-integration/v1/schemas/result-artifact-v2.schema.json (per-finding payload pattern) and /tmp/gentle-ai/internal/components/sdd/boundedreview.go:13 (nativeReviewerResultSchema constant). Intentionally forked to map gentle-ai's per-artifact admission shape (sha256/lineage_id/lens) to our per-finding payload shape (location/severity/claim/evidence_class/causal_disposition/proof_refs).

location.description: file:line reference. ONE location per finding. Path must NOT contain commas (enforced by `^[^,]+:\d+$`); for multi-line defects, emit one finding per location and reference subsequent locations in proof_refs[].

severity.description: BLOCKER/CRITICAL/WARNING/SUGGESTION. Disjoint from spec-phase drift guards [RED]/[ORANGE]/[YELLOW].

evidence_class.description: deterministic = tool output proves the finding; inferential = cause inferred; insufficient = partial evidence.

causal_disposition.description: How the candidate relates to baseline. Default 'unknown' when comparison is not available.

proof_refs.description: Concrete evidence (rg output lines, test failure logs, tool stderr). Empty array allowed; field MUST be present.

sentinel_kind.description: Optional sentinel marker. `truncation` (qa-doctor): >20 diagnostics truncated, severity SUGGESTION. `coverage` (code-flow-analyst): unaudited section, severity WARNING. Absence = non-sentinel finding. The `:0` location suffix is a legacy convention; this field is the typed discriminator.
